verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for an open banking API platform, but there is no evidence of it here. Yapily's MCP server, llms.txt, and Agent Skills only give AI agents a searchable connection to the documentation. Nothing shows natural-language commands driving the product itself, such as initiating payments or retrieving account data. A docs-search MCP is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.
